   268	    };
   269	    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
   270	  }, [items.length > 0, matterId]);
   271	
   272	  if (items.length === 0) return null;
   273	
   274	  if (connected === false) {
   275	    return (
   276	      <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--kp-font-xs)', color: 'var(--color-muted-foreground)', padding: '8px 0' }}>
   277	        {/* eslint-disable lantern-i18n/no-hardcoded-string */}
   278	        Connect Wealthbox to send updates from this client.
   279	        {/* eslint-enable lantern-i18n/no-hardcoded-string */}
   280	      </div>
   281	    );
   282	  }
   283	  if (connected !== true) return null;
   284	
   285	  const selectable = items.filter((i) => RETRYABLE_STATUSES.includes(i.status));
   286	  const selectedItems = selectable.filter((i) => !uncheckedIds.has(i.id));
   287	  const selectedIds = selectedItems.map((i) => i.id);
   288	  const hasBlankFieldBlend = selectedItems.some((i) => i.kind === 'field' && (i.finalValue ?? '').trim() === '');
   289	  const approveDisabled = selectedIds.length === 0 || effectiveHousehold === null || hasBlankFieldBlend;
   290	
   291	  function toggle(id: string) {
   292	    setUncheckedIds((prev) => {
   293	      const next = new Set(prev);
   294	      if (next.has(id)) next.delete(id);
   295	      else next.add(id);
   296	      return next;
   297	    });
   298	  }
   299	
   300	  function handleApprove() {
   301	    if (effectiveHousehold === null || selectedIds.length === 0) return;
   302	    const household_ = effectiveHousehold;
   303	    const approvedIds = selectedIds;
   304	    const shouldFileCompliance = fileComplianceNote;
   305	    // Codex review catch (P2): reset immediately, not after the note is
   306	    // filed — a still-checked toggle would otherwise summarize its OWN
   307	    // compliance note on the next approval, recursing indefinitely. The
   308	    // toggle must be re-checked deliberately for each new summary.
   309	    if (shouldFileCompliance) setFileComplianceNote(false);
   310	    void approve(approvedIds, household_).then(() => {
   311	      if (!shouldFileCompliance) return;
   312	      // Read fresh state after approve() settles — the sent items just
   313	      // landed in the store, and this must never fire for rows that failed
   314	      // or are still pending. The compliance note is only ever ENQUEUED
   315	      // here, exactly like every other item — it goes through the same
   316	      // Approve button on this card's next render, never a direct send.
   317	      const sentJustNow = useCrmWriteQueueStore
   318	        .getState()
   319	        .items.filter((i) => i.matterId === matterId && approvedIds.includes(i.id) && i.status === 'sent');
   320	      if (sentJustNow.length === 0) return;
   321	      const matter = matters.find((m) => m.id === matterId);
   322	      const clientLabel = matter ? matterLabel(matter) : matterId;
   323	      const { title, body } = composeComplianceNote(sentJustNow, {
   324	        clientLabel,
   325	        whenIso: new Date().toISOString(),
   326	      });
   327	      enqueue({ kind: 'note', matterId, title, body, sourceRef: `compliance:${new Date().toISOString()}` });
   328	    });
   329	  }
   330	
   331	  function handleRetry(id: string) {
   332	    if (effectiveHousehold === null) return;
   333	    void approve([id], effectiveHousehold);
   334	  }
   335	
   336	  return (
   337	    <Card
   338	      variant="raised"
   339	      style={{ marginTop: 'var(--kp-space-xs)', padding: expanded ? undefined : 0, overflow: 'hidden' }}
   340	    >
   341	      {/* eslint-disable lantern-i18n/no-hardcoded-string */}
   342	      {!expanded && (
   343	        <button
   344	          type="button"
   345	          data-testid="crm-write-card-collapsed"
   346	          onClick={() => { setExpanded(true); }}
   347	          style={{
   348	            display: 'flex',
   349	            alignItems: 'center',
   350	            gap: 12,
   351	            width: '100%',
   352	            padding: 'var(--kp-space-xs) var(--kp-card-pad)',
   353	            border: 'none',
   354	            background: 'transparent',
   355	            cursor: 'pointer',
   356	            textAlign: 'left',
   357	            fontFamily: 'var(--font-sans)',
   358	          }}
   359	        >
   360	          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 2, minWidth: 0, flex: 1 }}>
   361	            <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--kp-font-sm)', fontWeight: 'var(--kp-weight-semibold)', color: 'var(--kp-navy)' }}>
   362	              Update Wealthbox
   363	            </span>
   364	            <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--kp-font-2xs)', color: 'var(--color-muted-foreground)' }}>
   365	              {summaryLabel(items)} ready for review
   366	            </span>
   367	          </div>
   368	          <span
   369	            style={{
   370	              display: 'inline-flex',
   371	              alignItems: 'center',
   372	              gap: 4,
   373	              fontSize: 'var(--kp-font-2xs)',
   374	              fontWeight: 'var(--kp-weight-bold)',
   375	              color: 'var(--kp-accent, var(--kp-navy))',
   376	              flexShrink: 0,
   377	            }}
   378	          >
   379	            Review
   380	            <ChevronRight size={14} strokeWidth={2} />
   381	          </span>
   382	        </button>
   383	      )}
   384	
   385	      {expanded && (
   386	        <div>
   387	          <div
   388	            style={{
   389	              display: 'flex',
   390	              alignItems: 'center',
   391	              gap: 10,
   392	              padding: 'var(--kp-space-xs) var(--kp-card-pad)',
   393	              borderBottom: '1px solid var(--color-border)',
   394	            }}
   395	          >
   396	            <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 1, flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
   397	              <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--kp-font-sm)', fontWeight: 'var(--kp-weight-bold)', color: 'var(--kp-navy)' }}>
   398	                Update Wealthbox
   399	              </span>
   400	              <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--kp-font-2xs)', color: 'var(--color-muted-foreground)' }}>
   401	                Nothing sends until you approve
   402	              </span>
   403	            </div>
   404	            <button
   405	              type="button"
   406	              aria-label="Collapse"
   407	              onClick={() => { setExpanded(false); }}
   408	              style={{ border: 'none', background: 'transparent', cursor: 'pointer', color: 'var(--color-muted-foreground)', padding: 4 }}
   409	            >
   410	              <ChevronUp size={16} strokeWidth={1.75} />
   411	            </button>
   412	          </div>
   413	
   414	          {householdKeys.length === 0 && (
   415	            <div style={{ padding: 'var(--kp-card-pad)', fontSize: 'var(--kp-font-xs)', color: 'var(--color-muted-foreground)' }}>
   416	              Link this client to a Wealthbox household first.
   417	            </div>
   418	          )}
   419	
   420	          {householdKeys.length > 1 && (
   421	            <div style={{ padding: 'var(--kp-space-xs) var(--kp-card-pad)', background: 'var(--kp-bg-soft, #f8f9fb)', borderBottom: '1px solid var(--color-border)' }}>
   422	              <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--kp-font-xs)', fontWeight: 'var(--kp-weight-semibold)', color: 'var(--kp-navy)', marginBottom: 8 }}>
   423	                This client links to two Wealthbox households. Pick where these changes should go.
   424	              </div>
   425	              {householdKeys.map((key) => (
   426	                <label
   427	                  key={key}
   428	                  data-testid={`crm-household-${key}`}
   429	                  style={{
   430	                    display: 'flex',
   431	                    alignItems: 'center',
   432	                    gap: 8,
   433	                    padding: '7px 10px',
   434	                    marginBottom: 6,
   435	                    border: `1px solid ${household === key ? 'var(--kp-action-border, var(--kp-navy))' : 'var(--color-border)'}`,
   436	                    borderRadius: 'var(--radius-md)',
   437	                    background: household === key ? 'var(--kp-action-bg, #eef1ff)' : '#fff',
   438	                    cursor: 'pointer',
   439	                  }}
   440	                >
   441	                  <input
   442	                    type="radio"
   443	                    name={`crm-household-${matterId}`}
   444	                    checked={household === key}
   445	                    onChange={() => { setHousehold(key); }}
   446	                    style={{ accentColor: 'var(--kp-navy)', width: 16, height: 16, cursor: 'pointer' }}
   447	                  />
   448	                  <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--kp-font-xs)', color: 'var(--kp-navy)' }}>{key}</span>
   449	                </label>
   450	              ))}
   451	            </div>
   452	          )}
   453	
   454	          {householdKeys.length > 0 && (
   455	            <div style={{ padding: '10px var(--kp-card-pad) 2px' }}>
   456	              {items.map((item) => (
   457	                <CrmWriteRow
   458	                  key={item.id}
   459	                  item={item}
   460	                  checked={!uncheckedIds.has(item.id)}
   461	                  onToggle={() => { toggle(item.id); }}
   462	                  onRetry={() => { handleRetry(item.id); }}
   463	                  onDismiss={() => { dismiss(item.id); }}
   464	                  onFinalValueChange={(value) => { updateFinalValue(item.id, value); }}
   465	                />
   466	              ))}
   467	            </div>
   468	          )}
   469	
   470	          {householdKeys.length > 0 && (
   471	            <label
   472	              style={{
   473	                display: 'flex',
   474	                alignItems: 'center',
   475	                gap: 8,
   476	                padding: '0 var(--kp-card-pad) var(--kp-space-xs)',
   477	                fontSize: 'var(--kp-font-2xs)',
   478	                color: 'var(--color-muted-foreground)',
   479	                cursor: 'pointer',
   480	              }}
   481	            >
   482	              <input
   483	                type="checkbox"
   484	                data-testid="file-compliance-note"
   485	                checked={fileComplianceNote}
   486	                onChange={(e) => { setFileComplianceNote(e.target.checked); }}
   487	                style={{ width: 14, height: 14, cursor: 'pointer' }}
   488	              />
   489	              Also file a compliance note
   490	            </label>
   491	          )}
   492	
   493	          {householdKeys.length > 0 && (
   494	            <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 14, padding: '0 var(--kp-card-pad) var(--kp-card-pad)' }}>
   495	              <Button variant="primary" size="md" disabled={approveDisabled} onClick={handleApprove}>
   496	                Approve {pluralize(selectedIds.length, 'change')}
   497	              </Button>
   498	              <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--kp-font-2xs)', color: 'var(--color-muted-foreground)' }}>
   499	                Nothing is written to Wealthbox until you approve.
   500	              </span>
   501	            </div>
   502	          )}
   503	        </div>
   504	      )}
   505	      {/* eslint-enable lantern-i18n/no-hardcoded-string */}
   506	    </Card>
   507	  );
   508	}
   509	
   510	const KIND_LABEL: Record<ProposedCrmWrite['kind'], string> = {
   511	  note: 'Note',
   512	  task: 'Task',
   513	  field: 'Field update',
   514	};
   515	
   516	function CrmWriteRow({
   517	  item,
   518	  checked,
   519	  onToggle,
   520	  onRetry,
   521	  onDismiss,
   522	  onFinalValueChange,
   523	}: {
   524	  item: ProposedCrmWrite;
   525	  checked: boolean;
   526	  onToggle: () => void;
   527	  onRetry: () => void;
   528	  onDismiss: () => void;
   529	  onFinalValueChange: (value: string) => void;
   530	}) {
   531	  const isSent = item.status === 'sent';
   532	  const isSending = item.status === 'sending';
   533	  const isFailed = item.status === 'failed';
   534	  const isVerifyPending = item.status === 'verify_pending';
   535	  const isStale = item.status === 'stale';
   536	  const isField = item.kind === 'field';
   537	  const needsAttention = isFailed || isVerifyPending || isStale;
   538	
   539	  return (
   540	    <div
   541	      style={{
   542	        display: 'flex',
   543	        alignItems: 'flex-start',
   544	        gap: 10,
   545	        padding: '12px 14px',
   546	        marginBottom: 8,
   547	        borderRadius: 'var(--radius-md)',
   548	        // Field rows stay neutral at the row level — the tracked-changes
   549	        // green lives on the Blended column alone, since Existing/From this
   550	        // meeting are reference, not the proposed change (see fieldBlend.ts).
   551	        background: isSent ? '#fff' : needsAttention ? 'var(--kp-warning-bg)' : isField ? '#fff' : 'var(--kp-success-bg)',
   552	        border: `1px solid ${isSent ? 'var(--color-border)' : needsAttention ? 'var(--kp-warning-line)' : isField ? 'var(--color-border)' : 'var(--kp-success-line)'}`,
   553	      }}
   554	    >
   555	      {/* eslint-disable lantern-i18n/no-hardcoded-string */}
   556	      {isSent ? (
   557	        <span
   558	          style={{
   559	            width: 18, height: 18, borderRadius: '50%', flexShrink: 0, marginTop: 1,
   560	            display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', justifyContent: 'center',
   561	            background: 'var(--kp-success)', color: '#fff',
   562	          }}
   563	        >
   564	          <Check size={11} strokeWidth={3} />
   565	        </span>
   566	      ) : (
   567	        <input
   568	          type="checkbox"
   569	          checked={checked}
   570	          onChange={onToggle}
   571	          disabled={isSending}
   572	          style={{
   573	            marginTop: 3,
   574	            flexShrink: 0,
   575	            width: 16,
   576	            height: 16,
   577	            accentColor: 'var(--kp-success)',
   578	            cursor: isSending ? 'default' : 'pointer',
   579	          }}
   580	        />
   581	      )}
   582	
   583	      <div style={{ flex: 1, minWidth: 0 }}>
   584	        <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--kp-font-2xs)', fontWeight: 'var(--kp-weight-semibold)', color: 'var(--color-muted-foreground)', textTransform: 'uppercase', letterSpacing: '0.04em' }}>
   585	          {KIND_LABEL[item.kind]}
   586	        </div>
   587	        <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--kp-font-sm)', fontWeight: 'var(--kp-weight-semibold)', color: isField ? 'var(--kp-navy)' : '#0a4d38' }}>
   588	          {item.title}
   589	        </div>
   590	
   591	        {isField ? (
   592	          <div style={{ display: 'flex', flexDirection: 'column', gap: 8, marginTop: 8 }}>
   593	            <FieldColumn label="Existing" testId={`crm-field-existing-${item.id}`} value={item.existingValue ?? ''} />
   594	            <FieldColumn label="From this meeting" testId={`crm-field-new-${item.id}`} value={item.newValue ?? ''} />
   595	            <div>
   596	              <div
   597	                style={{
   598	                  display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 5,
   599	                  fontSize: 'var(--kp-font-2xs)', fontWeight: 'var(--kp-weight-semibold)', color: '#0a5c43', marginBottom: 4,
   600	                }}
   601	              >
   602	                <Pencil size={11} strokeWidth={2} />
   603	                Blended — edit before approving
   604	              </div>
   605	              <textarea
   606	                data-testid={`crm-field-blended-${item.id}`}
   607	                value={item.finalValue ?? ''}
   608	                onChange={(e) => { onFinalValueChange(e.target.value); }}
   609	                disabled={isSending || isSent}
   610	                rows={3}
   611	                style={{
   612	                  width: '100%',
   613	                  resize: 'vertical',
   614	                  fontFamily: 'var(--font-sans)',
   615	                  fontSize: 'var(--kp-font-xs)',
   616	                  lineHeight: 1.5,
   617	                  color: '#0a5c43',
   618	                  background: 'var(--kp-success-bg)',
   619	                  border: '1px solid var(--kp-success-line)',
   620	                  borderRadius: 'var(--radius-sm)',
   621	                  padding: '7px 9px',
   622	                  outlineColor: 'var(--kp-success)',
   623	                }}
   624	              />
   625	            </div>
   626	          </div>
   627	        ) : (
   628	          <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--kp-font-xs)', color: '#0a5c43', marginTop: 3 }}>
   629	            {item.body}
   630	          </div>
   631	        )}
   632	
   633	        <div style={{ display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 10, flexWrap: 'wrap', marginTop: 6 }}>
   634	          {item.kind === 'task' && item.dueDate != null && (
   635	            <span style={{ display: 'inline-flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 4, fontSize: 'var(--kp-font-2xs)', fontWeight: 'var(--kp-weight-semibold)', color: '#0a5c43' }}>
   636	              <CalendarDays size={12} strokeWidth={1.75} />
   637	              Due {item.dueDate}
   638	            </span>
   639	          )}
   640	          <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--kp-font-2xs)', color: 'var(--color-muted-foreground)' }}>
   641	            from: {item.sourceRef}
   642	          </span>
   643	          {isSent && <span style={{ fontSize: 'var(--kp-font-2xs)', fontWeight: 'var(--kp-weight-semibold)', color: 'var(--kp-success)' }}>In Wealthbox</span>}
   644	        </div>
   645	
   646	        {needsAttention && (
   647	          <div
   648	            style={{
   649	              display: 'flex', alignItems: 'center', gap: 7, marginTop: 8, padding: '7px 10px',
   650	              border: '1px solid var(--kp-warning-line)', borderRadius: 'var(--radius-md)',
   651	              background: '#fff', color: '#7a4a1a', fontSize: 'var(--kp-font-2xs)', fontWeight: 500,
   652	            }}
   653	          >
   654	            <AlertTriangle size={14} strokeWidth={1.9} color="var(--kp-warning)" />
   655	            {isFailed
   656	              ? "Couldn't reach Wealthbox"
   657	              : isStale
   658	                ? 'This field changed in Wealthbox since the proposal. Review again.'
   659	                : 'Delivery unconfirmed. Will verify on next try.'}
   660	            <button
   661	              type="button"
   662	              onClick={onRetry}
   663	              style={{
   664	                marginLeft: 'auto', border: '1px solid var(--kp-warning-line)', background: '#fff', color: '#7a4a1a',
   665	                fontFamily: 'var(--font-sans)', fontSize: 'var(--kp-font-2xs)', fontWeight: 700, cursor: 'pointer',
   666	                borderRadius: 'var(--radius-sm)', padding: '3px 10px',
   667	              }}
   668	            >
   669	              Retry
   670	            </button>
   671	          </div>
   672	        )}
   673	      </div>
   674	
   675	      {!isSent && !isSending && (
   676	        <button
   677	          type="button"
   678	          onClick={onDismiss}
   679	          style={{ fontSize: 'var(--kp-font-2xs)', color: 'var(--color-muted-foreground)', background: 'none', border: 'none', cursor: 'pointer', padding: 2, flexShrink: 0 }}
   680	        >
   681	          Dismiss
   682	        </button>
   683	      )}
   684	      {/* eslint-enable lantern-i18n/no-hardcoded-string */}
   685	    </div>
   686	  );
   687	}
   688	
   689	function FieldColumn({ label, testId, value }: { label: string; testId: string; value: string }) {
   690	  return (
   691	    <div>
   692	      <div style={{ fontSize: 'var(--kp-font-2xs)', fontWeight: 'var(--kp-weight-semibold)', color: 'var(--color-muted-foreground)', marginBottom: 4 }}>
   693	        {label}
   694	      </div>
   695	      <div
   696	        data-testid={testId}
   697	        style={{
   698	          fontSize: 'var(--kp-font-xs)',
   699	          lineHeight: 1.5,
   700	          color: 'var(--kp-navy)',
   701	          background: 'var(--kp-bg-soft, #f8f9fb)',
   702	          border: '1px solid var(--color-border)',
   703	          borderRadius: 'var(--radius-sm)',
   704	          padding: '7px 9px',
   705	          // Coordinator review catch (P3): a plain <div> collapses newlines,
   706	          // so a multi-paragraph narrative value (e.g. background_information)
   707	          // rendered as one run-on line — the advisor wasn't seeing the true
   708	          // text they were approving against.
   709	          whiteSpace: 'pre-wrap',
   710	        }}
   711	      >
   712	        {value}
   713	      </div>
   714	    </div>
   715	  );
   716	}
   717	/**
   718	 * Composes the optional, approval-gated "compliance summary" CRM note from the
   719	 * receipts of a just-approved review-card send. Pure; no IO. Consent/retention
   720	 * lines appear only when the caller supplies them (Wave 3+ meeting sources).
   721	 */
   722	
   723	import type { ProposedCrmWrite } from '@/platform/state/crmWriteQueueStore';
   724	
   725	export interface ComplianceNoteMeta {
   726	  clientLabel: string;
   727	  whenIso: string;
   728	  consent?: { status: 'noted' | 'standing' | 'not-applicable'; method?: string; atIso?: string };
   729	  retentionPolicy?: string;
   730	}
   731	
   732	// Codex review catch (P2, Task 9c integration): this hardcoded to Note/Task
   733	// before field updates existed, so an approved field write showed up in the
   734	// compliance record mislabeled as "Task" — a real accuracy problem for a
   735	// compliance/audit artifact.
   736	function crmWriteKindLabel(kind: ProposedCrmWrite['kind']): string {
   737	  switch (kind) {
   738	    case 'note': return 'Note';
   739	    case 'task': return 'Task';
   740	    case 'field': return 'Field update';
   741	  }
   742	}
   743	
   744	export function composeComplianceNote(
   745	  items: ProposedCrmWrite[],
   746	  meta: ComplianceNoteMeta,
   747	): { title: string; body: string } {
   748	  const sent = items.filter((i) => i.status === 'sent');
   749	  const lines: string[] = [
   750	    `Compliance summary for ${meta.clientLabel}`,
   751	    `Approved by the advisor: ${meta.whenIso}`,
   752	    '',
   753	    'Records filed:',
   754	    ...sent.map(
   755	      (i) => `- ${crmWriteKindLabel(i.kind)}: "${i.title}" (receipt ${i.remoteId ?? 'pending'}; source ${i.sourceRef})`,
   756	    ),
   757	  ];
   758	  if (meta.consent) {
   759	    lines.push(
   760	      '',
   761	      `Consent: ${meta.consent.status}${meta.consent.method ? ` (${meta.consent.method})` : ''}${meta.consent.atIso ? ` at ${meta.consent.atIso}` : ''}`,
   762	    );
   763	  }
   764	  if (meta.retentionPolicy) lines.push(`Retention policy: ${meta.retentionPolicy}`);
   765	  return { title: `Compliance summary: ${meta.clientLabel} (${meta.whenIso.slice(0, 10)})`, body: lines.join('\n') };
   766	}
   767	/**
   768	 * MatterNotesEditor — live collaborative notes for a shared matter.
   769	 *
   770	 * Binds a CodeMirror 6 editor to `doc.getText('notes')` on a MatterSyncClient's
   771	 * Yjs document via y-codemirror.next's `yCollab` extension. Two clients sharing
   772	 * the same matter key will see each other's edits converge in real time.
   773	 *
   774	 * Fail-closed: when `syncClient` is null (key unavailable, walled, or not yet
   775	 * published) the editor is replaced with a friendly message and no editor
   776	 * mounts — nothing to leak.
   777	 *
   778	 * Disk mirror: on meaningful local change we debounce-write the notes text to
   779	 * `<first folderPath of the matter>/matter-notes.md` via WorkspaceService. This
   780	 * is a READ-ONLY artifact of the synced truth — solo tooling and search still
   781	 * see it. Never write to it directly; the Yjs doc is the source of truth.
   782	 *
   783	 * Presence (remote cursors): y-codemirror.next exposes cursor awareness via
   784	 * `yRemoteSelections` when an `awareness` object is passed to `yCollab`. The
   785	 * MatterSyncClient does NOT expose an awareness channel on its public API (the
   786	 * relay is a dumb pipe for opaque update blobs only — there is no separate
   787	 * awareness broadcast channel). Therefore presence is SKIPPED in this release.
   788	 * Adding it would require either: (a) an awareness channel on the relay (new
   789	 * backend endpoint), or (b) a side-channel in the Yjs doc itself. Neither is
   790	 * in scope for Task 4. Cursor awareness is the named next increment.
   791	 */
   792	
   793	import { useEffect, useRef, useCallback, useState } from 'react';
   794	import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next';
   795	import { EditorState } from '@codemirror/state';
   796	import { EditorView, keymap, drawSelection } from '@codemirror/view';
   797	import { defaultKeymap, history, historyKeymap } from '@codemirror/commands';
   798	import { syntaxHighlighting, defaultHighlightStyle } from '@codemirror/language';
   799	import { markdown, markdownLanguage } from '@codemirror/lang-markdown';
   800	import { yCollab } from 'y-codemirror.next';
   801	import { Send } from 'lucide-react';
   802	import type { MatterSyncClient } from '@/platform/firm/MatterSyncClient';
   803	import type { Matter } from '@/platform/types/matter';
   804	import { useMatterSyncStatus } from '@/platform/matter/matterSyncStore';
   805	import { useCrmWriteQueueStore } from '@/platform/state/crmWriteQueueStore';
   806	import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';
   807	
   808	/** How long the "added" confirmation stays visible after Send to Wealthbox. */
   809	const SEND_CONFIRMATION_MS = 2500;
   810	
   811	/** Split the note text into a Wealthbox-ready (title, body) pair: title is
   812	 *  the first non-blank line, body is everything after it (or the same text
   813	 *  again when the note is a single line, so the body is never empty). */
   814	function splitNoteForCrm(text: string): { title: string; body: string } {
   815	  const trimmed = text.trim();
   816	  const newlineIdx = trimmed.indexOf('\n');
   817	  if (newlineIdx === -1) return { title: trimmed, body: trimmed };
   818	  return { title: trimmed.slice(0, newlineIdx).trim(), body: trimmed.slice(newlineIdx + 1).trim() };
   819	}
   820	
   821	/** How often (ms) we debounce-write the disk mirror. */
   822	const DISK_MIRROR_DEBOUNCE_MS = 2000;
   823	
   824	interface MatterNotesEditorProps {
   825	  matter: Matter;
   826	  /** The running sync client. Null triggers the fail-closed render. */
   827	  syncClient: MatterSyncClient | null;
   828	  /**
   829	   * WorkspaceService instance used to mirror notes to disk. If omitted the
   830	   * disk mirror is skipped (e.g. in tests without a workspace).
   831	   */
   832	  workspaceService?: { writeFile: (path: string, content: string) => Promise<void> } | null;
   833	  className?: string;
   834	}
   835	
   836	/** Label the sync status badge for the user (i18n key suffix). */
   837	function statusI18nKey(
   838	  status: ReturnType<typeof useMatterSyncStatus>,
   839	): string {
   840	  switch (status) {
   841	    case 'live': return 'status-live';
   842	    case 'connecting': return 'status-connecting';
   843	    case 'catching-up': return 'status-catching-up';
   844	    case 'offline': return 'status-offline';
   845	    case 'error': return 'status-error';
   846	    default: return 'status-idle';
   847	  }
   848	}
   849	
   850	function statusDotClass(
   851	  status: ReturnType<typeof useMatterSyncStatus>,
   852	): string {
   853	  switch (status) {
   854	    case 'live': return 'bg-green-500';
   855	    case 'connecting':
   856	    case 'catching-up': return 'bg-yellow-400';
   857	    case 'offline': return 'bg-gray-400';
   858	    case 'error': return 'bg-red-500';
   859	    default: return 'bg-gray-300';
   860	  }
   861	}
   862	
   863	export function MatterNotesEditor({
   864	  matter,
   865	  syncClient,
   866	  workspaceService,
   867	  className,
   868	}: MatterNotesEditorProps) {
   869	  const { t } = useTranslation();
   870	  const syncStatus = useMatterSyncStatus(matter.id);
   871	  const editorContainerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
   872	  const editorViewRef = useRef<EditorView | null>(null);
   873	  const diskMirrorTimerRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
   874	  const [noteText, setNoteText] = useState(() => {
   875	    // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-base-to-string -- Y.Text.toString() is the documented way to read its content (same pattern as the EditorState.create() call below).
   876	    return syncClient?.doc.getText('notes').toString() ?? '';
   877	  });
   878	  // Codex review catch (P2): if this component instance is reused for a
   879	  // DIFFERENT client (syncClient changes without unmounting), the lazy
   880	  // useState initializer above only ran once — noteText would keep the
   881	  // previous client's text until the user typed, and "Send to Wealthbox"
   882	  // could queue the wrong client's note under the new matter.id. React's
   883	  // "adjust state during render" pattern resyncs it without the cascading-
   884	  // render effect-setState lint issue.
   885	  const [prevSyncClient, setPrevSyncClient] = useState(syncClient);
   886	  if (syncClient !== prevSyncClient) {
   887	    setPrevSyncClient(syncClient);
   888	    // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-base-to-string -- see above.
   889	    setNoteText(syncClient?.doc.getText('notes').toString() ?? '');
   890	  }
   891	  const [sentConfirmation, setSentConfirmation] = useState(false);
   892	  const enqueueCrmWrite = useCrmWriteQueueStore((s) => s.enqueue);
   893	  // BUG-032 (data loss): flushes the latest pending disk-mirror write. Set while
   894	  // a write is debounced; called on unmount so navigating away within the
   895	  // debounce window doesn't silently drop the last lines of notes. Cleared once
   896	  // the timer fires normally so a later unmount never double-writes.
   897	  const flushDiskMirrorRef = useRef<(() => void) | null>(null);
   898	
   899	  const writeDiskMirror = useCallback(
   900	    async (text: string) => {
   901	      if (!workspaceService) return;
   902	      const folder = matter.folderPaths[0];
   903	      if (!folder) return;
   904	      try {
   905	        await workspaceService.writeFile(`${folder}/matter-notes.md`, text);
   906	      } catch (err) {
   907	        // Non-fatal: the Yjs doc is the source of truth.
   908	        console.warn('[MatterNotesEditor] disk mirror write failed:', err);
   909	      }
   910	    },
   911	    [workspaceService, matter.folderPaths],
   912	  );
   913	
   914	  // Schedule a debounced write of the notes text to the first matter folder.
   915	  const scheduleDiskMirror = useCallback(
   916	    (text: string) => {
   917	      if (!workspaceService) return;
   918	      const folder = matter.folderPaths[0];
   919	      if (!folder) return;
   920	      if (diskMirrorTimerRef.current) clearTimeout(diskMirrorTimerRef.current);
   921	      flushDiskMirrorRef.current = () => { void writeDiskMirror(text); };
   922	      diskMirrorTimerRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
   923	        flushDiskMirrorRef.current = null;
   924	        void writeDiskMirror(text);
   925	      }, DISK_MIRROR_DEBOUNCE_MS);
   926	    },
   927	    [workspaceService, matter.folderPaths, writeDiskMirror],
   928	  );
   929	
   930	  useEffect(() => {
   931	    if (!editorContainerRef.current || !syncClient) return;
   932	    // Already mounted (StrictMode double-effect).
   933	    if (editorViewRef.current) return;
   934	
   935	    const yText = syncClient.doc.getText('notes');
   936	
   937	    // Light theme matching the rest of the markdown editor. We keep it minimal:
   938	    // no line numbers (notes are short), same font size + monospace as MarkdownEditor.
   939	    const lightTheme = EditorView.theme(
   940	      {
   941	        '&': {
   942	          height: '100%',
   943	          fontSize: '14px',
   944	          fontFamily: 'ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, monospace',
   945	          background: '#ffffff',
   946	        },
   947	        '.cm-content': {
   948	          padding: '12px 16px',
   949	          minHeight: '100%',
   950	          caretColor: '#1a1a1a',
   951	          color: '#1a1a1a',
   952	        },
   953	        '.cm-focused': { outline: 'none' },
   954	        '.cm-editor': { height: '100%' },
   955	        '.cm-scroller': { overflow: 'auto', height: '100%' },
   956	        '.cm-gutters': { background: '#f9fafb', borderRight: '1px solid #e5e7eb', color: '#9ca3af' },
   957	        '.cm-cursor': { borderLeftColor: '#1a1a1a' },
   958	        '.cm-selectionBackground': { background: '#dbeafe !important' },
   959	        '.cm-activeLineGutter': { background: '#f3f4f6' },
   960	      },
   961	      { dark: false },
   962	    );
   963	
   964	    // y-codemirror.next: yCollab with null awareness (no presence channel).
   965	    // Passing `false` for undoManager so UndoManager doesn't interfere with
   966	    // the app's own undo stack on close.
   967	    const collabExtension = yCollab(yText, null, { undoManager: false });
   968	
   969	    // Mirror text to disk on every local doc update (debounced), and keep
   970	    // noteText in sync so the "Send to Wealthbox" button reflects the live
   971	    // content (including remote peers' edits, which yCollab applies as a
   972	    // CodeMirror transaction too).
   973	    const diskMirrorExtension = EditorView.updateListener.of((update) => {
   974	      if (update.docChanged) {
   975	        const text = update.state.doc.toString();
   976	        scheduleDiskMirror(text);
   977	        setNoteText(text);
   978	      }
   979	    });
   980	
   981	    const state = EditorState.create({
   982	      doc: yText.toString(),
   983	      extensions: [
   984	        history(),
   985	        keymap.of([...defaultKeymap, ...historyKeymap]),
   986	        drawSelection(),
   987	        syntaxHighlighting(defaultHighlightStyle),
   988	        markdown({ base: markdownLanguage }),
   989	        lightTheme,
   990	        collabExtension,
   991	        diskMirrorExtension,
   992	      ],
   993	    });
   994	
   995	    const view = new EditorView({
   996	      state,
   997	      parent: editorContainerRef.current,
   998	    });
   999	    editorViewRef.current = view;
  1000	
  1001	    return () => {
  1002	      if (diskMirrorTimerRef.current) {
  1003	        clearTimeout(diskMirrorTimerRef.current);
  1004	        // Flush the latest notes so leaving within the debounce window doesn't
  1005	        // silently drop the last lines (BUG-032, data loss).
  1006	        flushDiskMirrorRef.current?.();
  1007	      }
  1008	      view.destroy();
  1009	      editorViewRef.current = null;
  1010	    };
  1011	  }, [syncClient, scheduleDiskMirror]);
  1012	
  1013	  const handleSendToWealthbox = useCallback(() => {
  1014	    const { title, body } = splitNoteForCrm(noteText);
  1015	    if (!title) return;
  1016	    enqueueCrmWrite({ kind: 'note', matterId: matter.id, title, body, sourceRef: `note:${matter.id}` });
  1017	    setSentConfirmation(true);
  1018	    setTimeout(() => { setSentConfirmation(false); }, SEND_CONFIRMATION_MS);
  1019	  }, [noteText, matter.id, enqueueCrmWrite]);
  1020	
  1021	  // Fail-closed: no sync client means no access.
  1022	  if (!syncClient) {
  1023	    return (
  1024	      <div
  1025	        data-testid="matter-notes-no-access"
  1026	        className={cn('flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-full text-center px-6', className)}
  1027	      >
  1028	        <div className="text-4xl mb-3 opacity-40">&#128274;</div>
  1029	        <p className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground/80 mb-1">
  1030	          {t('matter.notes.no-access')}
  1031	        </p>
  1032	        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground max-w-xs">
  1033	          {t('matter.notes.no-access-hint')}
  1034	        </p>
  1035	      </div>
  1036	    );
  1037	  }
  1038	
  1039	  return (
  1040	    <div
  1041	      data-testid="matter-notes-editor"
  1042	      className={cn('flex flex-col h-full bg-white', className)}
  1043	    >
  1044	      {/* Header: matter name + sync status badge + subtitle */}
  1045	      <div className="flex items-start justify-between px-4 py-3 border-b bg-gray-50">
  1046	        <div className="min-w-0">
  1047	          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
  1048	            <h2 className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900 truncate">
  1049	              {t('matter.notes.title')}
  1050	            </h2>
  1051	            {/* Sync status badge */}
  1052	            <span
  1053	              data-testid="matter-notes-sync-badge"
  1054	              className="flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-gray-500 shrink-0"
  1055	              aria-label={t(`matter.notes.${statusI18nKey(syncStatus)}`)}
  1056	            >
  1057	              <span className={cn('inline-block w-2 h-2 rounded-full', statusDotClass(syncStatus))} />
  1058	              {t(`matter.notes.${statusI18nKey(syncStatus)}`)}
  1059	            </span>
  1060	          </div>
  1061	          <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-0.5">
  1062	            {t('matter.notes.subtitle')}
  1063	          </p>
  1064	        </div>
  1065	        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
  1066	          {sentConfirmation && (
  1067	            <span data-testid="matter-notes-sent-confirmation" className="text-xs text-emerald-700">
  1068	              {t('matter.notes.sent-to-wealthbox')}
  1069	            </span>
  1070	          )}
  1071	          <button
  1072	            type="button"
  1073	            data-testid="matter-notes-send-to-wealthbox"
  1074	            onClick={handleSendToWealthbox}
  1075	            disabled={noteText.trim() === ''}
  1076	            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-medium text-gray-700 border border-gray-300 rounded-md px-2.5 py-1.5 bg-white hover:bg-gray-50 disabled:opacity-40 disabled:cursor-default disabled:hover:bg-white"
  1077	          >
  1078	            <Send className="w-3.5 h-3.5" strokeWidth={1.75} />
  1079	            {t('matter.notes.send-to-wealthbox')}
  1080	          </button>
  1081	        </div>
  1082	      </div>
  1083	
  1084	      {/* Editor surface */}
  1085	      <div
  1086	        ref={editorContainerRef}
  1087	        data-testid="matter-notes-cm-editor"
  1088	        className="flex-1 overflow-hidden"
  1089	        aria-label={`${matter.name} shared notes`}
  1090	      />
  1091	    </div>
  1092	  );
  1093	}

     3	//! Mirrors the mail connector's command/state/keychain patterns exactly.

    36	pub struct CrmState {
    37	    pub workspace: tokio::sync::Mutex<Option<PathBuf>>,
    38	    pub is_syncing: Arc<AtomicBool>,
    39	    pub cancel: Arc<AtomicBool>,
    40	    pub last_report: tokio::sync::Mutex<Option<CrmSyncReportDto>>,
    41	    /// Live count of households processed so far in the CURRENT sync. The engine
    42	    /// stores the running total per matter; `crm_sync_status` reads it so a watching
    43	    /// user sees steady movement instead of a stale number that jumps at the end.
    44	    pub progress_households: Arc<std::sync::atomic::AtomicU32>,
    45	    /// Separate from `cancel` (which cancels an in-flight sync): lets the
    46	    /// frontend abort a pending interactive OAuth sign-in (`crm_oauth_connect`'s
    47	    /// wait for the browser redirect) without touching sync state. See
    48	    /// `crm_oauth_connect_cancel`.
    49	    pub oauth_cancel: Arc<AtomicBool>,
    50	    /// Shared across every `crm_create_note`/`crm_create_task` call for the
    51	    /// life of the running app — see `write::WriteInFlightGuard` for why this
    52	    /// can't live on the per-call `CrmStore` instead.
    53	    pub write_guard: write::WriteInFlightGuard,
    54	    /// Count of `crm_create_note`/`crm_create_task` calls currently in
    55	    /// flight (POST sent, ledger not yet settled). Disconnect waits for this
    56	    /// to drain to zero before purging, mirroring how it already waits on
    57	    /// `is_syncing` — otherwise a write started just before disconnect could
    58	    /// still POST to Wealthbox (with the about-to-be-revoked token) while
    59	    /// local state is mid-purge. See `WriteInFlightSlot`.
    60	    pub write_in_flight: Arc<std::sync::atomic::AtomicUsize>,
    61	    /// Set by disconnect before it waits for `write_in_flight` to drain; a
    62	    /// NEW write checks this and refuses to start rather than racing a
    63	    /// disconnect that's already underway.
    64	    pub disconnect_requested: Arc<AtomicBool>,
    65	    /// Set by every crm_connect/crm_oauth_connect success path from the
    66	    /// moment it starts waiting for in-flight writes to drain until the
    67	    /// token swap AND the stale-sent-row downgrade have both completed; a
    68	    /// NEW write checks this and refuses to start rather than possibly
    69	    /// reading the OLD token (or racing the downgrade) during a reconnect
    70	    /// that's already underway. See `ConnectInProgressGuard`.
    71	    pub connect_in_progress: Arc<AtomicBool>,
    72	    /// Provider ids (see `CrmProvider::id`) whose stale-row downgrade
    73	    /// failed (persistent, post-retries) at workspace-open time via
    74	    /// `crm_set_workspace`. Unlike a connect (a discrete user action that
    75	    /// can just refuse and ask the user to retry), `crm_set_workspace` runs
    76	    /// automatically on workspace open — hard-failing it would block the
    77	    /// user from opening their workspace at all over a transient ledger
    78	    /// hiccup. Instead a provider's presence in this set blocks NEW writes
    79	    /// FOR THAT PROVIDER (mirroring `disconnect_requested`/
    80	    /// `connect_in_progress`) until a LATER successful downgrade check
    81	    /// (another `crm_set_workspace` call, or a future connect's own check,
    82	    /// for the SAME provider) removes it — see

    84	    /// unconfirmed downgrade can't be trusted silently. Per-provider (not a
    85	    /// single flag): a different provider's successful downgrade must never
    86	    /// clear an unrelated provider's still-unconfirmed one.
    87	    pub downgrade_unconfirmed: tokio::sync::Mutex<std::collections::HashSet<String>>,
    88	}

    90	pub fn manage_state(app: &tauri::App) {

    92	        workspace: tokio::sync::Mutex::new(None),

    99	        write_in_flight: Arc::new(std::sync::atomic::AtomicUsize::new(0)),
   100	        disconnect_requested: Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(false)),
   101	        connect_in_progress: Arc::new(AtomicBool::new(false)),
   102	        downgrade_unconfirmed: tokio::sync::Mutex::new(std::collections::HashSet::new()),
   103	    });
   104	}

   106	/// RAII guard: decrements `write_in_flight` when dropped, covering all exit
   107	/// paths (normal return, early return via `?`, and panic) — pairs with the
   108	/// increment in `crm_create_write`.
   109	struct WriteInFlightSlot(Arc<std::sync::atomic::AtomicUsize>);
   110	impl Drop for WriteInFlightSlot {
   111	    fn drop(&mut self) {
   112	        self.0.fetch_sub(1, Ordering::SeqCst);
   113	    }
   114	}
   115	
   116	/// RAII guard: sets `is_syncing` to false when dropped, covering all exit paths
   117	/// (normal return, early return, and panic).
   118	struct SyncGuard(Arc<AtomicBool>);
   119	impl Drop for SyncGuard {
   120	    fn drop(&mut self) {
   121	        self.0.store(false, Ordering::SeqCst);
   122	    }
   123	}

   150	/// Sync summary DTO returned by `crm_sync_all` and stored as the last report.

   230	/// Emitted after a durable audit entry is written by the CRM backend so the
   231	/// frontend can push it into the live Activity-Log React state without waiting
   232	/// for the next workspace re-open.  Payload: `AuditEntryRecord` (camelCase JSON).
   233	const CRM_AUDIT_APPENDED_EVENT: &str = "crm-audit-appended";
   234	
   235	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   236	// Durable audit helper
   237	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
   238	
   239	/// Append one CRM audit entry to the encrypted audit store and notify the
   240	/// frontend so it appears in the live Activity-Log view immediately.
   241	///
   242	/// # Workspace resolution
   243	/// Prefers the `AuditState` workspace (the same path that `audit_list` and
   244	/// `audit_append` use) so the entry is visible as soon as it is written.
   245	/// Falls back to the `CrmState` workspace when `AuditState` has not been set
   246	/// yet (should not happen in normal use — both are set together at workspace
   247	/// open — but is handled defensively).
   248	///
   249	/// # Best-effort contract
   250	/// Any failure (keychain unavailable, I/O error, spawn panic) is logged as a
   251	/// `warn!` and **never** propagates to the calling command.  The id is
   252	/// `audit_crm_<nanos>_<4-byte-hex>` (unique per call within the nanosecond
   253	/// range of the system clock) and the timestamp is RFC 3339.
   254	///
   255	/// # Live Activity-Log update
   256	/// After a successful DB write the `crm-audit-appended` Tauri event is emitted
   257	/// with the `AuditEntryRecord` as the payload.  The frontend listener in
   258	/// `useWorkspaceLifecycle.ts` pushes the record into the `auditEntries` React
   259	/// state, making the entry visible without a workspace re-open.
   260	/// Build the `payload_json` for a CRM audit entry as a FULL camelCase `AuditEntry`
   261	/// shape.
   262	///
   263	/// The frontend persists each entry by serialising the whole `AuditEntry` into
   264	/// `payloadJson` and reconstructs it on load with `JSON.parse(payloadJson) as
   265	/// AuditEntry` (`recordToEntry`). A thin payload with no `metadata` key therefore
   266	/// yields `entry.metadata === undefined`, and the Activity Log white-screens the
   267	/// entire app when `getAuditEntryMatterScope` reads `metadata['scope']` unguarded.
   268	/// So every CRM entry carries a real `metadata` object. CRM connect/sync/disconnect
   269	/// are workspace-wide rather than tied to one matter, so the scope is `allMatters`.
   270	fn crm_audit_payload_json(id: &str, timestamp: &str, action: &str, description: &str) -> String {
   271	    serde_json::json!({
   272	        "id": id,
   273	        "timestamp": timestamp,
   274	        "action": action,
   275	        "description": description,
   276	        "model": serde_json::Value::Null,
   277	        "inputs": {},
   278	        "outputs": {},
   279	        "userDecision": serde_json::Value::Null,
   280	        "metadata": {
   281	            "auditEventType": action,
   282	            "source": "crm-backend",
   283	            "scope": { "kind": "allMatters" },
   284	        },
   285	    })
   286	    .to_string()
   287	}
   288	
   289	async fn append_crm_audit_best_effort(app: &AppHandle, action: &str, description: &str) {
   290	    use crate::commands::audit::store::{AuditEntryRecord, EncryptedAuditStore};
   291	
   292	    // Resolve workspace: AuditState first (guarantees same DB as audit_list),
   293	    // then CrmState as a fallback.
   294	    let ws_opt: Option<std::path::PathBuf> = {
   295	        let audit_ws = app.state::<AuditState>().workspace.lock().await.clone();
   296	        if audit_ws.is_some() {
   297	            audit_ws
   298	        } else {
   299	            app.state::<CrmState>().workspace.lock().await.clone()
   300	        }
   301	    };
   302	    let Some(ws) = ws_opt else {
   303	        log::warn!("crm audit append skipped (non-fatal): no workspace path available");
   304	        return;
   305	    };
   306	
   307	    let action_s = action.to_string();
   308	    let desc_s = description.to_string();
   309	
   310	    let result = tokio::task::spawn_blocking(move || -> anyhow::Result<AuditEntryRecord> {
   311	        let store = EncryptedAuditStore::open(&ws)?;
   312	
   313	        let timestamp = chrono::Utc::now().to_rfc3339();
   314	        let nanos = std::time::SystemTime::now()
   315	            .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)
   316	            .map(|d| d.as_nanos())
   317	            .unwrap_or_default();
   318	        let mut rng_bytes = [0u8; 4];
   319	        rand::RngCore::fill_bytes(&mut rand::thread_rng(), &mut rng_bytes);
   320	        let id = format!("audit_crm_{}_{}", nanos, hex::encode(rng_bytes));
   321	
   322	        let payload_json = crm_audit_payload_json(&id, &timestamp, &action_s, &desc_s);
   323	
   324	        let rec = AuditEntryRecord {
   325	            id,
   326	            timestamp,
   327	            action: action_s,
   328	            description: desc_s,
   329	            payload_json,
   330	        };
   331	        store.append(&rec)?;
   332	        Ok(rec)
   333	    })
   334	    .await;
   335	
   336	    match result {
   337	        Ok(Ok(rec)) => {
   338	            // Notify the frontend so it can push the entry into the live
   339	            // `auditEntries` React state without a workspace re-open.
   340	            let _ = app.emit(CRM_AUDIT_APPENDED_EVENT, &rec);
   341	        }
   342	        Ok(Err(e)) => log::warn!("crm audit append failed (non-fatal): {e:#}"),
   343	        Err(e) => log::warn!("crm audit spawn failed (non-fatal): {e}"),
   344	    }
   345	}
   346	
   347	/// Wait (bounded, 10s — matching `crm_disconnect_logic_for_provider`'s own
   348	/// `is_syncing` wait budget) for any write ALREADY in flight to finish
   349	/// BEFORE a connect path overwrites the token and downgrades the ledger.
   350	/// Returns `true` once drained, `false` on timeout.
   351	///
   352	/// The caller MUST refuse to proceed (not swap the token) on `false` rather
   353	/// than proceeding anyway — `post_json` can legitimately keep a write alive
   354	/// far longer than 10s under heavy 429 throttling (`MAX_429_RETRIES` = 6,
   355	/// each capped at `MAX_RETRY_AFTER_SECS` = 120s), so a short wait can easily
   356	/// time out during a perfectly healthy, still-in-progress write. Blocking
   357	/// the connect command for the many minutes that would take to rule out
   358	/// is worse UX than failing fast and asking the user to try again shortly
   359	/// (the same trade-off `crm_disconnect_logic_for_provider` already makes:
   360	/// short wait, then defer rather than either a long hang or an unsafe

     1	//! CRM write path — approval-gated note/task creation.
     2	//!
     3	//! Same PII discipline as `client.rs`: response bodies and user content are
     4	//! never logged; errors carry status codes and endpoint paths only.
     5	
     6	use sha2::{Digest, Sha256};
     7	
     8	#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]
     9	pub enum CrmWriteKind {
    10	    Note,
    11	    Task,
    12	}
    13	
    14	impl CrmWriteKind {
    15	    pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str {
    16	        match self {
    17	            Self::Note => "note",
    18	            Self::Task => "task",
    19	        }
    20	    }

    23	/// One proposed write. `household_key` is the provider-side contact/household
    24	/// id (Wealthbox: numeric string; other providers use their prefixed crm_key).
    25	/// `source_ref` is provenance for the audit log (document path or transcript
    26	/// timestamp) — it is never sent to the CRM.
    27	///
    28	/// `requested_at` identifies the APPROVAL EVENT, not the content — the
    29	/// caller (the review-card UI) generates it once when the user clicks
    30	/// Approve and reuses the SAME value for any automatic retry of that exact
    31	/// approval (a crash, a timeout, an ambiguous 5xx). A fresh, later approval
    32	/// of identical content (e.g. a recurring "Left voicemail" note) must
    33	/// generate a NEW `requested_at`. This is what lets `dedup_key` protect
    34	/// against retry duplication without also silently suppressing an
    35	/// intentional repeat send — see `dedup_key_is_scoped_to_the_approval_event_not_content_alone`.
    36	#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
    37	pub struct CrmWriteRequest {
    38	    pub kind: CrmWriteKind,
    39	    pub matter_id: String,
    40	    pub household_key: String,
    41	    pub title: String,
    42	    pub body: String,
    43	    pub due_date: Option<String>,
    44	    pub source_ref: String,
    45	    pub requested_at: String,
    46	}

    48	/// Receipt for a completed (or deduplicated) write.

    50	#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
    51	pub struct WriteReceipt {
    52	    /// Provider-side id of the created record.
    53	    pub remote_id: String,
    54	    /// True when the ledger suppressed a duplicate instead of re-posting.
    55	    pub deduped: bool,
    56	}

    58	#[derive(Debug, thiserror::Error)]
    59	pub enum CrmWriteError {
    60	    #[error("{0} is not connected")]
    61	    NotConnected(&'static str),
    62	    #[error("this client is not linked to a CRM household")]
    63	    NoHouseholdLink,
    64	    #[error("this client is linked to more than one CRM household — pick one in the review card")]
    65	    AmbiguousHousehold,
    66	    #[error("CRM write failed (HTTP {0})")]
    67	    Http(u16),
    68	    #[error("CRM write throttled past retry budget")]
    69	    Throttled,
    70	    #[error("a previous identical write may have been delivered — verification pending, retry shortly")]
    71	    VerifyPending,
    72	    #[error("this exact write is already being sent — wait a moment before retrying")]
    73	    InProgress,
    74	    #[error("writes are not yet supported for {0}")]
    75	    NotSupported(&'static str),
    76	    #[error("invalid write request: {0}")]
    77	    InvalidInput(&'static str),
    78	    #[error("could not record this write before sending it — try again")]
    79	    LedgerUnavailable,
    80	    // Codex round 6 (self-converge): the current value IS included here
    81	    // (unlike other error variants that deliberately never embed raw
    82	    // response bodies) — it's the SAME field the advisor is already
    83	    // reviewing in this exact flow, not unrelated data from a raw API
    84	    // response, and the review card needs it to re-render the 3 columns
    85	    // with the fresh value rather than just showing a generic "it changed".
    86	    #[error("this field changed in the CRM since the proposal — current value: {0}")]
    87	    StaleFieldValue(String),
    88	    #[error("could not read the current field value from the CRM — try again")]
    89	    ReadFailed,
    90	}

    92	fn norm(s: &str) -> String {
    93	    s.split_whitespace().collect::<Vec<_>>().join(" ")
    94	}
    95	
    96	/// Stable content-addressed key scoped to ONE approval event: identical
    97	/// (provider-visible) writes from the SAME approval collide (protecting a
    98	/// retry from double-posting), but the same content approved again later —
    99	/// a different `requested_at` — produces a fresh key, so an intentional
   100	/// repeat send is never silently suppressed as a "duplicate" forever.
   101	///
   102	/// SCHEMA-EVOLUTION NOTE: this hash formula changed (added `requested_at`)
   103	/// after `crm_outbound_writes` already existed. That's safe today because
   104	/// this write-back feature has never shipped — the only caller
   105	/// (`crm_create_note`/`crm_create_task`) has no frontend wrapper yet (Task
   106	/// 8/9), so no real workspace anywhere has a ledger row computed under the
   107	/// pre-`requested_at` formula. If this hash formula changes AGAIN after the
   108	/// feature ships, that future change needs either a migration for existing
   109	/// rows or a fallback lookup under the old formula — skipping that then
   110	/// would let a retry miss its own `sent`/`pending_verify` row and double-post.
   111	pub fn dedup_key(req: &CrmWriteRequest) -> String {
   112	    let mut h = Sha256::new();
   113	    for part in [
   114	        req.kind.as_str(),
   115	        &req.household_key,
   116	        &norm(&req.title),
   117	        &norm(&req.body),
   118	        req.due_date.as_deref().unwrap_or(""),
   119	        // Codex round 6 (self-converge, P3): trim before hashing —
   120	        // validate_requested_at already validates the TRIMMED value parses
   121	        // as RFC3339, but hashing the raw string would let incidental
   122	        // whitespace (e.g. a caller-side copy/paste or serialization quirk)
   123	        // on a retry of the SAME approval produce a DIFFERENT key, missing
   124	        // its own pending/sent row and risking a duplicate send.
   125	        req.requested_at.trim(),
   126	    ] {
   127	        h.update(part.as_bytes());
   128	        h.update([0u8]); // field separator so "a","bc" != "ab","c"
   129	    }
   130	    hex::encode(h.finalize())
   131	}
   132	
   133	/// One proposed field-level "blended update" (Task 9c) — a single
   134	/// allowlisted narrative field on a household/contact, set to a user-edited
   135	/// blend of the existing value and what a source (e.g. a meeting)
   136	/// contributed. `existing_value` is what the review card showed the user;
   137	/// the stale-guard (`push_crm_field_update`) re-fetches the live value at
   138	/// approve time and refuses to write blind if it no longer matches.
   139	///
   140	/// `dedup_key_field` (the WRITE-SAFETY ledger key) deliberately does NOT
   141	/// include `requested_at`: unlike a note/task (each approval should create
   142	/// a SEPARATE record, so retry-vs-repeat needs the approval event to tell
   143	/// them apart), a field update is a PUT, idempotent by HTTP semantics —
   144	/// re-approving the identical (household_key, field, final_value) is
   145	/// correctly a no-op (the field is already at the desired value), not a
   146	/// lost write.
   147	///
   148	/// `requested_at` DOES matter for the AUDIT id, though (codex round 10,
   149	/// self-converge): without an approval-event identifier there, a genuine
   150	/// retry (the command's response was lost, `push_crm_field_update` now
   151	/// sees the live value already equals `final_value` and reports
   152	/// `deduped: true`) is indistinguishable from a LATER, separate approval
   153	/// that happens to restore the same value — one wants the SAME audit
   154	/// entry (no duplicate), the other wants its OWN. See `crm_update_field`'s
   155	/// audit-key computation.
   156	#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
   157	pub struct CrmFieldUpdateRequest {
   158	    pub matter_id: String,
   159	    pub household_key: String,
   160	    pub field: String,
   161	    pub existing_value: String,
   162	    pub new_value: String,
   163	    pub final_value: String,
   164	    pub source_ref: String,
   165	    pub requested_at: String,
   166	}
   167	
   168	/// Stable content-addressed key for a field update: identical (household_key,
   169	/// field, final_value) collide (a retry, or re-approving an unchanged blend,
   170	/// is a safe no-op); a different target or final value produces a fresh key.
   171	pub fn dedup_key_field(req: &CrmFieldUpdateRequest) -> String {
   172	    let mut h = Sha256::new();
   173	    for part in [
   174	        "field",
   175	        &req.household_key,
   176	        &norm(&req.field),
   177	        // Codex round 4 (self-converge): the EXACT final_value, not
   178	        // norm()'d — push_crm_field_update compares live values exactly
   179	        // (formatting/paragraph-breaks are part of what the user
   180	        // approved), so the ledger/audit key must distinguish two
   181	        // approvals that differ only in formatting too. Colliding them
   182	        // would let the second (formatting-only) approval's audit entry be
   183	        // silently suppressed as a "duplicate" of the first (both compute
   184	        // the same deterministic audit id), and could wrongly reject a
   185	        // concurrent one as "in progress".
   186	        req.final_value.as_str(),
   187	    ] {
   188	        h.update(part.as_bytes());
   189	        h.update([0u8]);
   190	    }
   191	    hex::encode(h.finalize())
   192	}

   194	/// Provider-agnostic CRM write surface. Wealthbox is the first implementation;
   195	/// Redtail/Salesforce adopt the same trait once vendor creds land.
   196	#[async_trait::async_trait]
   197	pub trait CrmWriteSource: Send + Sync {
   198	    fn provider_id(&self) -> &'static str;
   199	    /// Creates a note, returning the provider-side remote id.
   200	    async fn create_note(&self, req: &CrmWriteRequest) -> Result<String, CrmWriteError>;
   201	    /// Creates a task, returning the provider-side remote id.
   202	    async fn create_task(&self, req: &CrmWriteRequest) -> Result<String, CrmWriteError>;
   203	    /// Look for an already-delivered identical write (recovery after an
   204	    /// ambiguous transport failure or a stale `pending` row). Returns the
   205	    /// remote id if found. `not_before` is this write's own first-attempt
   206	    /// time (the ledger row's `created_at`) — implementations that can see a
   207	    /// creation/update time on the candidate record should reject anything
   208	    /// older, so a pre-existing identical record can't false-positive as
   209	    /// proof this specific write landed.
   210	    async fn find_recent_matching(
   211	        &self,
   212	        req: &CrmWriteRequest,
   213	        not_before: chrono::DateTime<chrono::Utc>,
   214	    ) -> Result<Option<String>, CrmWriteError>;
   215	    /// Updates one allowlisted field on `req.household_key` to `req.final_value`.
   216	    /// Returns the provider-side id of the updated record. A PUT — safe to
   217	    /// retry with identical input (see `CrmFieldUpdateRequest`'s doc comment).
   218	    async fn update_field(&self, req: &CrmFieldUpdateRequest) -> Result<String, CrmWriteError>;
   219	    /// Fetches the CURRENT value of `field` on `household_key` — used by
   220	    /// `push_crm_field_update`'s stale-guard, which must re-check a blended
   221	    /// proposal against the live CRM value before ever writing it, since
   222	    /// someone else could have changed the field since the proposal was shown.
   223	    async fn get_contact_field(
   224	        &self,
   225	        household_key: &str,
   226	        field: &str,
   227	    ) -> Result<String, CrmWriteError>;
   228	}

   248	    async fn create_task(&self, req: &CrmWriteRequest) -> Result<String, CrmWriteError> {
   249	        let contact_id = wealthbox_contact_id(&req.household_key)?;
   250	        // VERIFY-LIVE: due_date format (plain date vs "YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm AM -0400").
   251	        // VERIFY-LIVE: whether Wealthbox actually REQUIRES a due_date for task
   252	        // creation is unconfirmed — `req.due_date` is allowed to be `None`
   253	        // and is simply omitted from the body in that case. Deliberately not
   254	        // adding a local "due_date required" validation without live-token
   255	        // confirmation: if Wealthbox turns out not to require it, that would
   256	        // incorrectly block a legitimate date-less task from ever being
   257	        // created. If it IS required, an unconfirmed local rule risks
   258	        // guessing wrong in the other direction. Confirm in Task 11's
   259	        // live probe (scripts/crm/wealthbox-write-probe.md).
   260	        let mut body = serde_json::json!({
   261	            "name": req.title.trim(),
   262	            "description": req.body.trim(),
   263	            "linked_to": [{"id": contact_id, "type": "Contact"}],
   264	        });
   265	        if let Some(d) = &req.due_date {
   266	            body["due_date"] = serde_json::Value::String(d.clone());
   267	        }
   268	        let resp = self.post_json("/tasks", &body).await.map_err(map_http_err)?;
   269	        remote_id_from(&resp)
   270	    }
   271	
   272	    async fn find_recent_matching(
   273	        &self,
   274	        req: &CrmWriteRequest,
   275	        not_before: chrono::DateTime<chrono::Utc>,
   276	    ) -> Result<Option<String>, CrmWriteError> {
   277	        // Recovery path: list recent objects and match on normalized content,
   278	        // target household, (for tasks) due_date, and a "not before" floor
   279	        // set from this write's own first-attempt time, so a pre-existing
   280	        // identical note/task cannot false-positive as proof this write
   281	        // landed. Full-list is acceptable at solo scale; the 1 rps gate
   282	        // bounds cost.
   283	        //
   284	        // VERIFY-LIVE: `CrmTask.created_at`/`updated_at` were added to mirror
   285	        // `CrmNote`'s fields for this exact check, but whether Wealthbox's
   286	        // real task response actually carries them (vs. only notes) is
   287	        // unconfirmed — `#[serde(default)]` means an absent field is simply
   288	        // "", which `wealthbox_time_at_or_after` already fails CLOSED on (not
   289	        // a match), so an untested assumption here degrades to "always
   290	        // resend on ambiguous task recovery" rather than a false positive.
   291	        let contact_id = wealthbox_contact_id(&req.household_key)?;
   292	        match req.kind {
   293	            CrmWriteKind::Note => {
   294	                let notes = self.list_notes(None).await.map_err(map_http_err)?;
   295	                let want = norm(&format!("{}\n\n{}", req.title.trim(), req.body.trim()));
   296	                Ok(notes
   297	                    .iter()
   298	                    .find(|n| {
   299	                        norm(&n.content) == want
   300	                            && n.linked_to.iter().any(|l| is_contact_link(l, contact_id))
   301	                            && wealthbox_time_at_or_after(&n.created_at, &n.updated_at, not_before)
   302	                    })
   303	                    .map(|n| n.id.to_string()))
   304	            }
   305	            CrmWriteKind::Task => {
   306	                let tasks = self.list_tasks(None).await.map_err(map_http_err)?;
   307	                Ok(tasks
   308	                    .iter()
   309	                    .find(|t| {
   310	                        norm(&t.name) == norm(req.title.trim())
   311	                            && norm(&t.description) == norm(req.body.trim())
   312	                            && t.due_date.as_deref().map(str::trim) == req.due_date.as_deref().map(str::trim)
   313	                            && t.linked_to.iter().any(|l| is_contact_link(l, contact_id))
   314	                            && wealthbox_time_at_or_after(&t.created_at, &t.updated_at, not_before)
   315	                    })
   316	                    .map(|t| t.id.to_string()))
   317	            }
   318	        }
   319	    }
   320	
   321	    async fn update_field(&self, req: &CrmFieldUpdateRequest) -> Result<String, CrmWriteError> {
   322	        validate_field_is_writable(&req.field)?;
   323	        let contact_id = wealthbox_contact_id(&req.household_key)?;
   324	        // VERIFY-LIVE: assumed PUT /contacts/{id} with a flat body
   325	        // (`{"<field>": "<value>"}`), mirroring the plan's own assumption
   326	        // for this endpoint. Confirm the exact envelope shape in the Task 11
   327	        // live probe (scripts/crm/wealthbox-write-probe.md) before relying
   328	        // on this against a real account.
   329	        let mut fields = serde_json::Map::new();
   330	        fields.insert(
   331	            wealthbox_wire_field_name(&req.field).to_string(),
   332	            serde_json::Value::String(req.final_value.clone()),
   333	        );
   334	        let body = serde_json::Value::Object(fields);
   335	        let resp = self
   336	            .put_json(&format!("/contacts/{contact_id}"), &body)
   337	            .await
   338	            .map_err(map_http_err)?;
   339	        remote_id_from(&resp)
   340	    }
   341	
   342	    async fn get_contact_field(
   343	        &self,
   344	        household_key: &str,
   345	        field: &str,
   346	    ) -> Result<String, CrmWriteError> {
   347	        let contact_id = wealthbox_contact_id(household_key)?;
   348	        // VERIFY-LIVE: assumed GET /contacts/{id} returns the same flat
   349	        // field name at the top level that PUT accepts (i.e. the contact
   350	        // record's JSON has a `<field>` key directly, not nested). Confirm
   351	        // in the Task 11 live probe.
   352	        let resp = self
   353	            .get_json(&format!("/contacts/{contact_id}"), &[])
   354	            .await
   355	            .map_err(map_http_err_for_read)?;
   356	        Ok(resp
   357	            .get(wealthbox_wire_field_name(field))
   358	            .and_then(|v| v.as_str())
   359	            .unwrap_or("")
   360	            .to_string())
   361	    }
   362	}

   140	 * Returns a structured result so callers can show an honest status message
   141	 * that only claims deletion when it actually happened.

   152	    : invoke<CrmDisconnectResult>('crm_disconnect');

   702	#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
   703	async fn crm_create_write(
   704	    app: AppHandle,
   705	    state: State<'_, CrmState>,
   706	    kind: CrmWriteKind,
   707	    matter_id: String,
   708	    title: String,
   709	    body: String,
   710	    due_date: Option<String>,
   711	    source_ref: String,
   712	    household_key: String,
   713	    requested_at: String,
   714	    provider: Option<String>,
   715	) -> Result<WriteReceipt, String> {
   716	    let provider = CrmProvider::from_optional(provider.as_deref())?;
   717	
   718	    // Register as in-flight BEFORE reading the token, so a disconnect that's
   719	    // already waiting on `write_in_flight` (see crm_disconnect_logic) sees us
   720	    // and doesn't purge underneath this call. If disconnect got there first
   721	    // (flag already set), bail immediately — better to reject the write than
   722	    // POST with a token that's about to be revoked. The guard decrements on
   723	    // every exit path (normal return, `?`, or panic).
   724	    state.write_in_flight.fetch_add(1, Ordering::SeqCst);
   725	    let _write_slot = WriteInFlightSlot(state.write_in_flight.clone());
   726	    if state.disconnect_requested.load(Ordering::SeqCst) {
   727	        return Err(format!(
   728	            "{} is disconnecting — try again once reconnected",
   729	            provider.display_name()
   730	        ));
   731	    }
   732	    if state.connect_in_progress.load(Ordering::SeqCst) {
   733	        return Err(format!(
   734	            "{} is reconnecting — try again in a moment",
   735	            provider.display_name()
   736	        ));
   737	    }
   738	    if state.downgrade_unconfirmed.lock().await.contains(provider.id()) {
   739	        return Err(
   740	            "CRM sync state couldn't be verified — try reopening your workspace before writing."
   741	                .to_string(),
   742	        );
   743	    }
   744	
   745	    write::validate_write_inputs(&title, &body).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
   746	    write::validate_requested_at(&requested_at).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
   747	
   748	    let token = read_token(provider).ok_or_else(|| {
   749	        format!(
   750	            "{} not connected — connect it in Account → Connections first",
   751	            provider.display_name()
   752	        )
   753	    })?;
   754	
   755	    let workspace = state
   756	        .workspace
   757	        .lock()
   758	        .await
   759	        .clone()
   760	        .ok_or("workspace not set — call crm_set_workspace first")?;
   761	
   762	    let store = CrmStore::open(&workspace).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
   763	    let client = write::write_client_for(provider, token).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
   764	
   765	    let req = CrmWriteRequest {
   766	        kind,
   767	        matter_id: matter_id.clone(),
   768	        household_key: household_key.clone(),
   769	        title,
   770	        body,
   771	        due_date,
   772	        source_ref: source_ref.clone(),
   773	        requested_at,
   774	    };
   775	
   776	    let action = provider.audit_action(match kind {
   777	        CrmWriteKind::Note => "create_note",
   778	        CrmWriteKind::Task => "create_task",
   779	    });
   780	
   781	    let write_dedup_key = write::dedup_key(&req);
   782	
   783	    match write::push_crm_write(client.as_ref(), &store, &state.write_guard, &req).await {
   784	        Ok(receipt) => {
   785	            // The audit id is deterministic (see append_crm_audit_best_effort_for_matter)
   786	            // and INSERT-OR-IGNORE at the store layer, so this is always safe
   787	            // to call even on a deduped receipt: a genuine retry of an
   788	            // already-audited write silently no-ops (no duplicate "pushed"
   789	            // entry), but a write that landed and whose process crashed
   790	            // BEFORE this call ever ran on its first attempt gets audited
   791	            // for the first time right here, on the recovering retry —
   792	            // instead of never being audited at all.
   793	            let description = format!(
   794	                "{} pushed to {} household {household_key} (source: {source_ref})",
   795	                kind.as_str(),
   796	                provider.display_name(),
   797	            );
   798	            append_crm_audit_best_effort_for_matter(
   799	                &app,
   800	                &action,
   801	                &description,
   802	                &matter_id,
   803	                Some(&write_dedup_key),
   804	            )
   805	            .await;
   806	            Ok(receipt)
   807	        }
   808	        // Wealthbox may already have accepted (even persisted) this write —
   809	        // record that possibility now rather than leaving the audit trail
   810	        // silent about a CRM change that may exist until a later retry
   811	        // resolves it. Distinct id suffix from the confirmed case above, so
   812	        // an eventual confirmation still gets its OWN audit entry rather
   813	        // than being silently ignored as a duplicate of this ambiguous one.
   814	        Err(CrmWriteError::VerifyPending) => {
   815	            let description = format!(
   816	                "{} MAY have been pushed to {} household {household_key} (source: {source_ref}) — delivery unconfirmed, will verify on retry",
   817	                kind.as_str(),
   818	                provider.display_name(),
   819	            );
   820	            append_crm_audit_best_effort_for_matter(
   821	                &app,
   822	                &action,
   823	                &description,
   824	                &matter_id,
   825	                Some(&format!("{write_dedup_key}_ambiguous")),
   826	            )
   827	            .await;
   828	            Err(CrmWriteError::VerifyPending.to_string())
   829	        }
   830	        Err(e) => Err(e.to_string()),
   831	    }
   832	}

   839	/// `existing_value` is what the review card showed the user (fetched at

   843	#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
   844	#[tauri::command]
   845	pub async fn crm_update_field(
   846	    app: AppHandle,
   847	    state: State<'_, CrmState>,
   848	    matter_id: String,
   849	    household_key: String,
   850	    field: String,
   851	    existing_value: String,
   852	    new_value: String,
   853	    final_value: String,
   854	    source_ref: String,
   855	    requested_at: String,
   856	    provider: Option<String>,
   857	) -> Result<WriteReceipt, String> {
   858	    let provider = CrmProvider::from_optional(provider.as_deref())?;
   859	
   860	    // Same in-flight/disconnect/reconnect coordination as crm_create_write —
   861	    // see its comments for why each check exists.
   862	    state.write_in_flight.fetch_add(1, Ordering::SeqCst);
   863	    let _write_slot = WriteInFlightSlot(state.write_in_flight.clone());
   864	    if state.disconnect_requested.load(Ordering::SeqCst) {

   866	            "{} is disconnecting — try again once reconnected",
   867	            provider.display_name()
   868	        ));
   869	    }

   871	        return Err(format!(
   872	            "{} is reconnecting — try again in a moment",

   874	        ));
   875	    }

   877	        return Err(
   878	            "CRM sync state couldn't be verified — try reopening your workspace before writing."
   879	                .to_string(),
   880	        );
   881	    }
   882	
   883	    write::validate_requested_at(&requested_at).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;
   884	
   885	    let token = read_token(provider).ok_or_else(|| {
   886	        format!(
   887	            "{} not connected — connect it in Account → Connections first",
   888	            provider.display_name()
   889	        )
   890	    })?;
   891	
   892	    let workspace = state
   893	        .workspace
   894	        .lock()
   895	        .await
   896	        .clone()
   897	        .ok_or("workspace not set — call crm_set_workspace first")?;

   904	        household_key: household_key.clone(),
   905	        field: field.clone(),
   906	        existing_value,
   907	        new_value,
   908	        final_value,
   909	        source_ref: source_ref.clone(),
   910	        requested_at: requested_at.clone(),
   911	    };
   912	
   913	    let action = provider.audit_action("field_updated");

   916	    // deliberately doesn't) — without it, a genuine retry (this exact
   917	    // command re-invoked after its response was lost) and a LATER, separate
   918	    // approval that happens to restore the same final_value are
   919	    // indistinguishable from content alone: one wants the SAME audit entry
   920	    // (no duplicate), the other wants its own. See CrmFieldUpdateRequest's
   921	    // doc comment.
   922	    //
   923	    // Trimmed here (self-converge, review findings on lp/crm-9c-rust):
   924	    // validate_requested_at accepts (and validates) the TRIMMED value, so a
   925	    // retry with incidental whitespace around an otherwise-identical
   926	    // requested_at must still compute the SAME audit id — hashing the raw
   927	    // string would let harmless whitespace defeat the INSERT OR IGNORE

   569	/// RAII claim on a dedup key — releases it on drop so an early return (via
   570	/// `?`) can never leave a key stuck claimed.
   571	struct InFlightClaim<'a> {
   572	    guard: &'a WriteInFlightGuard,
   573	    key: String,
   574	}
   575	impl Drop for InFlightClaim<'_> {
   576	    fn drop(&mut self) {
   577	        self.guard.release(&self.key);
   578	    }
   579	}
